reviewer_verdicts.best_finding: Every committed number re-derives bit-exact from the saved arm code + pool + official solutions (16 entries / 10 agreements / 8 gold / 0.80 precision / 20/24=0.8333 fresh rate / per-arm gold probe 5/16=0.3125, fresh 19/26=0.7308; arm0 reproduces 12/12 from probe transcripts; all 45 fresh transcripts structure-verified and gold-leak-free with the actual _fmt_grid serialization; both non-gold agreements are genuine wrong-wrong, hash-joins unique). Two findings sharpen the story: (1) the chain-mechanism claim survives my hostile confound battery — singles conditioned on the SAME 12 selected tasks are 5/24=0.2083 (selection explains nothing), and decomposing the fresh-arm histories shows iter0@600s=11/24 (timeout effect ns, p=0.17) while feedback recovered 9/13 iter0 failures, full-chain vs iter0-only at EQUAL timeout p=0.0073, vs same-task singles p=1.5e-5; (2) but the 0.80 agreement precision is statistically indistinguishable from just trusting any single fresh-chain arm (fresh gold rate 0.7308, P(>=8/10)=0.47), and even vs the 0.52 baseline it is only p=0.070 — the coverage gain (~10x: 10 events vs the singles round's 1/31) comes from the chain-rate lift, not from agreement adding precision. The weak probe arm0 (gold 0.3125, drags the ensemble) directly CAUSED one of the two prereg-killing wrong-wrong agreements: on 9aaea919 fresh_chain1 produced the GOLD answer but was outvoted by probe+fresh2 agreeing on a 22-cell-wrong grid.

reviewer_verdicts.best_finding: The two wrong agreements have OPPOSITE anatomies and only one is gate-fixable. 9aaea919 idx0: probe+fresh2 agree on a near-miss wrong output (hamming 22/900=2.4%, 30x30) while fresh_chain1 was demo-perfect with EXACT gold — majority-of-3 picks wrong 2-vs-1, unanimity would have abstained. 446ef5d2 idx0: ALL THREE arms unanimous on a hash-identical wrong output far from gold (hamming 310/676=45.9%, 26x26) with structurally disjoint code (normalized difflib 0.020-0.101; three different algorithm decompositions) = convergent wrong INFERENCE from rule-underdetermining demos, not correlated sampling; no arm had gold, so NO per-entry agreement variant rescues it (committed gate 10ev/8gold FAIL; unanimity 6/5 FAIL; unanimity-3of3 4/3 FAIL; fresh-only 7/6 FAIL). The ONE variant that passes the prereg-style bar is TASK-LEVEL unanimity (require unanimity on every input of a task — the arms' idx1 disagreement flags 446ef5d2's underdetermination): 5 events, 5/5 gold, coverage 0.3125 — explicitly POST-HOC, needs fresh pre-registered confirmation (and 2 of its 5 events are d8e07eb2, which carries the arm0 provenance caveat). Bonus within-run finding: fresh arms' iter0 single-shot rate 11/24=0.458 vs chain-final 20/24=0.833, 9/9 discordant improvements (McNemar exact p=0.0039) — cleaner chain-mechanism proof than the committed cross-round comparison.

reviewer_verdicts.best_finding: The 0.8333 fresh-chain rate decomposes into confounds, not chain mechanism: (1) identical-protocol cells (same 12 tasks, same 600s, same iter0 prompt) give singles-round 5/24=0.2083 vs chain-run iter0 11/24=0.4583 (Fisher p=0.062) — a ~2.2x pure between-run codex-variance multiplier explaining half the headline gap; (2) at the chain-run's own iter0 rate, iid 3-redraw predicts 0.841 lineage coverage vs 0.833 observed, and post-feedback calls succeed at 9/21=0.4286 ≈ iter0's 0.4583 — the refactor-FEEDBACK mechanism shows zero lift over independent redraws; (3) vs the probe, selection is inverted: arm0 is 12/12 by construction (probe full-pool 13/23=0.565), so 0.8333 is BELOW the probe on its own selected tasks and the full-pool extrapolation [0.435, 0.833] brackets the probe band. Timeout is a non-factor: 0/45 calls exceeded 300s (max 288.7s) and the singles round also ran at 600s. What survives: within-run multiple-draw coverage lift is real (11/24 to 20/24, sign test p=0.00195), agreement coverage on matched entries is 10/16 vs singles 0/16, and the prereg failure is honestly reported — including a 3-way unanimous WRONG agreement (446ef5d2). Precision framing also overclaims: 0.80 gate precision vs fresh-arm baseline 19/26=0.7308 is +0.07 n.s. (Fisher p=0.51), and the probe arm0's programs generalize far worse (5/16=0.3125, p=0.0094) yet appear in 7/10 agreements.

reviewer_verdicts.best_finding: PRE-REGISTERED BAR FAILED (10 events, 8 gold, rule required all gold) and the artifact reproduces bit-exact under fully independent re-execution (own sandbox/hash/gold-join: 16 entries, 10/16 agreement, 8/10 gold, 20/24 fresh, per-arm 5/16 probe / 19/26 fresh; 45 transcripts=45 calls, all leak-clean). The precision claim is statistically UNESTABLISHED: exact binomial P(X>=8|10,0.52)=0.0702, cluster-conservative collapse 6/8 tasks p=0.1724 (t-test/ICC variants p~0.03 are anti-conservative with 8 clusters and negative ICC), CP95 for 0.80 = [0.444,0.975] spanning 0.52, and vs this run's own fresh per-arm gold rate 19/26=0.731 agreement adds nothing (p=0.469); both d8e07eb2 gold events depend on the caveated arm0 (drop them: 6/8, p=0.172). Pooling adds ZERO clean independent prior events (aa4ec2a5 contaminated; the prior hybrid's 58f5dbd5 shares arm0 with this run). The MECHANISM claim, by contrast, is now properly nailed: my new task-matched baseline (prior fresh singles restricted to the same 12 tasks = 5/24 = 0.208, matching the global 0.20-0.26, killing the selection-bias objection) gives chains 20/24 vs singles 5/24 Fisher p=2.4e-5, and the timeout-controlled within-run feedback increment (iter0 11/24 -> chain 20/24) p=0.0073; CP95 LB of 0.8333 is 0.626, above BOTH prereg branches. Design flaw exposed: the all-gold acceptance rule's power DECREASES with coverage (10.7% at the realized 10 events under true p=0.80) - it was structurally near-unpassable at high coverage. Minor discrepancy: committed cost line '40 calls/4747.6s' mismatches the artifact (45 calls / 3780.0 codex-s / 1156.5 wall-s; per-task sums and transcript counts verify 45/3780.0).

synthesis.summary: VERDICT: CONFIRMED (5/5 hostile reviewers CONFIRMS; 4 minor, 1 major), with the major severity attaching to the committed INTERPRETATION, not the artifact. ARTIFACT AUTHENTICITY: unanimous and independently bit-exact across five separate re-derivation paths — 16 entries / 10 agreements / 8 gold / P(gold|agree)=0.800; fresh-chain demo-perfect 20/24=0.8333; per-arm gold probe 5/16=0.3125 vs fresh 19/26=0.7308; arm0 reproduces 12/12 from probe transcripts; 45 transcripts = 45 calls = exactly 3780.0 codex-s; 0 gold leaks in 45 prompts (detector validated 45/45 on test-input presence); 0 mislabels in 20,379 pool candidates; pool demos/test inputs hash-match official ARC-2 files; prereg protocol commit 9e1a070af (23:27:34) provably precedes transcripts (23:29–23:46) and landing bc8b2b9d0 (23:47:34). PREREG HONESTY: confirmed — the >=5-events-AND-all-gold bar (0.52^5=0.0380) was correctly evaluated NOT MET (10 events, 8 gold), preregistered_acceptance_met=false carried in the verdict string and landing commit. CLAIM-BY-CLAIM: (1) prereg-honestly-reported — CONFIRMED. (2) chain mechanism — CONFIRMED AS COVERAGE LIFT but 'decisively confirmed' needs narrowing: the cleanest controls are reviewer-constructed, not the registered ones (registered 0.52-0.57/0.20-0.26 bands were selection-confounded and cross-run): same-12-tasks same-600s singles 5/24=0.2083 vs chains 20/24, Fisher p=1.5e-5–2.4e-5; within-run iter0 11/24 -> chain-final 20/24, McNemar 9/9 discordant p=0.0039, equal-timeout p=0.0073; timeout itself ns (0/45 calls exceeded 300s). HOWEVER the feedback-vs-redraw question is OPEN (the major finding): post-feedback per-call success 9/21=0.4286 ≈ iter0 0.4583, and iid 3-redraw at the run's own iter0 rate predicts 0.841 lineage coverage vs 0.833 observed — the chain may be 'more draws', not error-correction; plus a measured 2.2x identical-protocol between-run codex variance (5/24 vs 11/24) makes ALL cross-run rate comparisons uninterpretable. (3) '0.80 precision at ~10x coverage' — coverage ~10x is REAL pool-wide (10/31 entries vs 1/31 singles) but the PRECISION framing is REFUTED as an uplift claim: exact binomial P(>=8/10|0.52)=0.0702 ns; vs the correct in-run comparator (fresh-arm gold rate 0.7308) p=0.469–0.51; CP95 [0.444,0.975] spans both nulls; cluster-conservative collapse 6/8 tasks p=0.172. The value of agreement is entry SELECTION (covered entries 0.833 per-arm vs uncovered 0.50) and confidence labeling, not conditional precision. WRONG-AGREEMENT ANATOMY: the two prereg-killing events have opposite anatomies — 9aaea919 (gate-fixable): weak probe arm0 (gold 0.3125) + fresh2 agreed on a 22/900-cell near-miss and OUTVOTED fresh_chain1's exact-gold answer (arm0 directly caused the failure); 446ef5d2 (not gate-fixable): 3/3 unanimous hash-identical wrong (hamming 310/676=45.9%) from structurally disjoint code (difflib 0.020-0.101) = convergent wrong inference from rule-underdetermining demos — no per-entry ensemble policy rescues it. The only variant passing the prereg-style bar is post-hoc TASK-LEVEL unanimity (sibling-input disagreement as underdetermination tripwire): 5/5 gold at 0.3125 coverage — requires fresh pre-registered confirmation. DESIGN FLAW: the all-gold rule's power DECREASES with coverage (10.7% at the realized 10 events under true p=0.80) — structurally near-unpassable; v2 must use a binomial critical-value rule (n=19 events >=14 gold: size 0.046 power 0.837 vs p=0.52; or n=24/>=17: 0.049/0.911). DEPLOYMENT FRONTIER (reviewer 5, offline, CPU-only): best measured stack is tau<=0.005 pool-snap > promote-first-FRESH-chain-raw-output > TRM vote at ARC-2 pass@1 19/31=0.6129 (vs banked 2/31, vote 1/31; 16 wins/0 losses, sign p=2e-5; ARC-1 sanity 28/31=0.9032); agreement-FIRST as a selector is net -1 pass@1 (18/31) — agreement is a CONFIDENCE LABEL, not a selector; fresh-fresh-only agreement labels 7/16 at 6/7=0.857. BOOKKEEPING ERROR (all 5 reviewers): committed cost line '40 calls/4747.6s' matches nothing on disk — artifact says 45 calls / 3780.0 codex-s / 1156.5 s wall; 4747.6 appears nowhere in ops/. Net: artifact and honesty stand; chain coverage-lift stands on reviewer-built matched controls; the precision-uplift framing and 'decisively confirmed' mechanism wording are overstatements that must be narrowed before any forward-facing claim or purchase decision.

title: Adversarial-verify round over the pre-registered GAP-4 k=3 chain-arms experiment
